content: Ooziyay, Iyo7aatamey, Akaazeynne Hizqiyaasi issoy issaafe kaalli kaallidi Yuhudan kawotida wode hessaththoka Iyo7aasa naa Iyorba7aamey Isra7eelen kawotida wode Bi7eere naa Hose7ekko yida GODAA qaalay hayssafe kaallizayssa.

GODAY Hose7e baggara Isra7eele naytas qaala buro yootishe Hose7es, «Ta derey taappe shaakettidi iita layma laymatiza gishshas neni baada issi laymatiza maccas nees machcho ekka; izippe nees nayta yela» gides.
Hessa gishshas Hose7ey biidi Dibilayeme nayo Goomero machcho ekkides; izakka qanththatada izas attuma naa yeladus.
Hessafe guye GODAY Hose7es, «Iyunne iza zereththati Izra7eelen wodhida asata geedon Iyu zereththata ta qaxxayana wodey haaho gidenna; Isra7eele kawoteththi hayssafe guye kundana mala ta ooththana.
He wode Izra7eele shoobban Isra7eele ola asa ubbaa ta menththereththana; hessa gishshas ne naaza sunththaa, ‹Izra7eele› gaada sunththa» gides.
Goomera qasseka qanththatada macca naa yeladus. GODAYKKA Hose7es, «Tani hayssafe guye Isra7eele asaas qadhettike; ta istta maarikke; hessa gishshas neni izi sunththaa, ‹Loruhama› ga sunththaa.
Yuhuda asaas gidikko tani ta siiqo bessana. Tani GODAY istta Xoossay ashshana; ta istta ashshanayssi ola wolqqan gidenna; mashshan, tooran woykko paraninne paran olizaytan gidenna» gides.
Goomera ba nayo dhanththi duuththidaappe guye qasseka qanththatada attuma naa yeladus.
GODAYKKA Hose7e, «Hayssafe guye Isra7eele asay ta dere gidenna; tanikka istta Xoos gidikke. Hessa gishshas neni ne naaza sunththaa, ‹Lo7aami› ga xeyga» gides.
Gidikkoka Isra7eele asay qooday baynda abban shaamintta mala darana. Ha7i Xoossi, «Intte ta dere deekketa» geetettidasohon, «Intte de7o Xoossa nayta» geetetti xeygettana wodey yaana.
He wode Yuhuda asaynne Isra7eele asay simmidi issino gidana. Nam7ati banttana ayssanaade issi as doorana. Qasseka istti bantta deren dichchaninne dureteththan de7ana. Izra7eele gallassay gita gidana.

footnotes.text: Loruhama guussi ta deraa ta maarikke guussa.
